arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS users_with_online_transaction FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE t.transaction_type = 'Online Transaction'
arguments.explanation: Counts the distinct users who made at least one online transaction on any of their cards.
assumptions: An online transaction is one with transaction_type = 'Online Transaction'.
Transactions are linked to users through the card used (transactions.card_id -> cards.user_id).
All transactions in the data are counted (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31), whatever their amount or error status, and whether or not they have a fraud label.
